units.name: Introduction
units.assessment: Can you name the conditions beyond classic chronic disease — trauma, critical illness, obesity, heart failure, COPD and aging — in which inflammation alone is enough to produce anemia?

lesson.title: Anemia of Inflammation
lesson.why: A brisk hematology-teaching introduction to anemia of inflammation as an entity in its own right - hepcidin-driven iron restriction, blunted erythropoietin response and shortened red cell survival - which is the frame needed before the chapter widens the list of triggers beyond classic chronic disease.

drills.name: Mechanism summary in three minutes
drills.title: The Mechanisms of Anemia in Chronic Disease

units.name: Pathophysiology
units.assessment: Can you describe the three mechanisms by which inflammation lowers hemoglobin — hepcidin-driven iron restriction, a blunted erythropoietin response, and shortened red cell survival — and say which one dominates?

lesson.title: Anemia of Chronic Disease (ACD): Pathophysiology, Diagnosis, and Management
lesson.why: A hematology-channel walkthrough of the pathophysiology, diagnosis and management of anemia of chronic disease with hepcidin at the centre of the explanation.

units.name: Diagnosis
units.assessment: Which iron-study pattern distinguishes anemia of inflammation from iron deficiency, and what does a normal-or-high ferritin with a low transferrin saturation and low TIBC tell you about coexisting iron deficiency?

lesson.title: Anemia of Inflammation vs Iron Deficiency: New Diagnostic Tools and Therapies
lesson.why: Built around the exact contrast this section tests - the iron-study pattern of inflammation against that of true iron deficiency - and it goes on to the newer diagnostic tools, including hepcidin and reticulocyte hemoglobin, used when the two coexist.

drills.name: Reading the iron panel
drills.title: Anemia: Lesson 2 - Interpreting the Iron Panel

units.name: Treatment
units.assessment: When is iron supplementation justified in anemia of inflammation, and what are the risks of reaching for an ESA or a transfusion instead of treating the underlying inflammatory disease?

lesson.title: Anemia of inflammation - Quick Review - By Pramil Cheriyath MD
lesson.why: A physician-led review that ends on management: treating the driving disease first, and the narrow circumstances in which iron or an ESA is appropriate.
